This specification defines the backend-first MVP for "Moment Diary" using Bun, TypeScript, Hono, and SQLite.

## Scope

The scope includes a complete RESTful API for diary management with user authentication. It covers user registration, login, diary CRUD, and a timeline view with filtering. No frontend is included.

## Technical Stack

- **Runtime**: [Bun](https://bun.sh)
- **Framework**: [Hono](https://hono.dev)
- **Database**: SQLite (via `bun:sqlite`)
- **Language**: TypeScript

## Data Model

### Database Path
`data/moment-diary.db`

### Tables

#### `users`
- `id`: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT
- `email`: TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL
- `password_hash`: TEXT NOT NULL
- `created_at`: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

#### `sessions`
- `token`: TEXT PRIMARY KEY
- `user_id`: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
- `created_at`: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

#### `diary_entries`
- `id`: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT
- `user_id`: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
- `title`: TEXT
- `content`: TEXT NOT NULL
- `mood`: TEXT
- `is_favorite`: INTEGER DEFAULT 0 (boolean 0/1)
- `created_at`: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
- `updated_at`: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

#### `tags`
- `id`: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT
- `user_id`: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)
- `name`: TEXT NOT NULL (original case)
- `normalized_name`: TEXT...
